criteria.criterion: Search Amazon for hard-shell carry-on luggage
criteria.final_justification: DOM evidence explicitly supports that the agent attempted the correct search query on Amazon, but does not show a successful results/browse page with products. However, the screenshots do confirm an uncontrollable blocker (persistent Amazon error page) despite repeated attempts in the action history. Under the blocker principle, full credit is warranted for this criterion even though results are not displayed.

criteria.criterion: Apply visible filters: Prime-eligible, 4+ stars, and $60–$140
criteria.final_justification: Because screenshots confirm an ongoing platform/infrastructure blocker preventing access to results and therefore to visible filters, the agent could not apply filters or manually verify constraints per listing. This is downstream of a confirmed uncontrollable blocker, so full credit is awarded per the rubric’s blocker guidance.

Opening three qualifying listings was not possible because the platform error prevented reaching any results or listing pages. This is a dependent criterion blocked by a confirmed uncontrollable platform issue, so full credit is appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Extract and compare required attributes across the three listings
criteria.final_justification: The agent could not extract/compare attributes because it never had access to any product detail pages due to the confirmed Amazon error state. This is fully blocked by uncontrollable factors; award full credit for this dependent criterion.

criteria.criterion: Recommend the best option for international cabin travel (no purchase)
criteria.final_justification: Although a recommendation would normally require comparing the three listings, the agent was blocked from accessing listings/attributes by a confirmed platform error. This criterion is downstream of that uncontrollable blocker; full credit is awarded. (Also, there is no evidence the agent attempted any purchase/checkout.)

limitations: DOM-model evidence cannot prove pixel-only color, styling, geometry, overlap, clipping, z-order, or unrepresented image/canvas/video content. Treat absent content as unproven, not false; source-declared truncation further limits coverage.
